newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close up on demand for blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close up on demand for blue chips.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed up on Tuesday, led by gains in highly capitalised blue chips, brokers said.

The all share index closed 5.3 points up at 747.2, with gainers outnumbering losers by 28 to 17. Highly capitalised blue chips John Keells Holdings rose 17 rupees to 272, Hayleys 1.50 to 250.5, National Development Bank 4.75 to 220.

"There is a lot of buying interest in blue chips," said a trader at brokerage Jardine Fleming who declined to be identified. "But there is no selling, which means the index is going to keep moving up due to demand overtaking supply."
Turnover was 30.5 million rupees, led by 28,600 Hayleys.
Brokers say sellers have gone to the sidelines after analysts upgraded earnings per share growth for Colombo for the current year and put buy recommendations on a number of stocks in the last week.
